vincent.role: The consultant with a battle plan. The approved look; the other four are built on his rig.
items: Short dark-brown hair with high temples, dark brows, short dark beard, a wide toothy grin.
Brown tweed jacket, white shirt, thin maroon tie, dark trousers, black shoes.
One pistol, the far hand on the grip.
Knife: an overhead slash and a stab.
Takes out his folded battle plan, reads it, smirks, puts it away.
Pistol to the sky, the far fist pumps behind his head, a hop.
Checks his watch, shakes the wrist, sighs, taps a foot.
Straightens his tie, chin up, smooths it down, a smug look.

thom.role: "Little Napoleon": the cocky gunslinger with 1900 headshots. One pixel shorter than VINCENT.
items: A navy cap worn backwards (the brim sticks out behind), a blond buzz cut under it, squinting happy eyes, a huge toothy grin, fair rosy skin, an ear that sticks out.
Dutch army camouflage: a sand base with olive and brown blotches and dark spots, painted along each arm and leg so it moves with the limb. Coyote combat boots.
Two pistols. The near one fires first, the far one four frames later, so every trigger pull sends two bullets.
Pistol whip: a chop with the pistol, and a jab with the butt.
Twirls one pistol twice on his trigger finger, blows the smoke off the muzzle, winks.
Both pistols up, a hop, one shot into the sky from each.
Spins both pistols, slides them into his belt, folds his arms, taps a boot, draws again with a wink.
Polishes a pistol on his shirt and admires it while a gleam runs along the barrel.
No pistols: a rising butt stroke and a stock jab with both hands on the heavy gun.

dirk.role: The plumber with exceptional combat skills. One column wider than VINCENT and one row taller (the hair spikes).
items: Messy spiky brown hair with a quiff, a thick drooping mustache, light stubble with a darker chin, a round rosy face, a narrow squint.
Fluorescent yellow hi-vis vest with grey reflective bands over a dark work polo, a tool belt with a pouch, navy work trousers with knee pads, heavy brown work boots.
Plunger: an overhead smack with a plop, and a thrust where the cup squashes flat and pops off. The plunger is its own set of hand parts, so a plumb bob can replace it without new poses.
Strokes his mustache twice with his eyes shut, nods, blinks.
Pistol up and the plunger raised behind his head like a trophy.
Blows on a steel thermos cup, a long sip, a sigh with steam, two foot taps.
A pipe wrench slaps into his palm, twirls a full turn and goes back on the belt.

bob.role: "Captain Climate": the superhero who saves the climate and flies to Istanbul every month. Slim build.
items: Brown hair with volume, swept up, short sides, blue eyes, pale skin, faint stubble, a slim face, a wide friendly smile.
A leaf-green suit with a white leaf on the chest, brown belt, gloves and knee-high boots.
Like the Israeli flag: white, a blue stripe near the shoulders and one near the hem, a blue six-pointed star in the middle. It is its own sprite behind the body and moves with every action.
One pistol in a gloved hand.
Hero punch: a haymaker and a straight jab, each with an impact burst.
A hero pose with the cape in the wind, then a guilty look at his boarding pass.
A spring onto his toes, the fist punches up and forward, the cape billows.
Checks his phone, the cape droops; a ding: a new flight, a guilty grin, the cape lifts.
A slow sip from a reusable bamboo cup, an “aah”, a thumbs-up.

patrick.role: The supernerd, AI fan and master of eating frikandellen.
items: Black hair with short sides and a slick swept-back top (a blue sheen on the crown), straight dark brows, a calm closed-mouth smile, a thin mustache, a strong jaw. No glasses, as in the photo.
Black zip jacket with a raised collar over a white t-shirt, a blue lanyard with a white badge, blue-black jeans, dark sneakers with white soles.
Keyboard: an overhead smash that knocks keycaps off, and a quick jab with the end of the board. Drawn by hand at five angles, so the keys stay clean.
Takes a frikandel out of his jacket, bites, chews, looks happy, bites again, puts the stub away.
The pistol up on the diagonal so his face and badge show, a big grin.
Plays a tiny handheld game, wins, loses interest; a second frikandel peeks from his jacket.
Types a question to his AI, waits for the dots, reads the long answer, grins and nods.
